# Bucks Heat Pumps

> MCS-certified air source heat pump installation for homes in Buckinghamshire, specialising in oil and LPG boiler replacement. Serving Aylesbury, Buckingham, Wendover, Princes Risborough, Winslow and the rural villages of North Buckinghamshire.

Bucks Heat Pumps is a heat-pump-only installation company based in Aylesbury, England. Every installation starts with a free room-by-room heat loss survey and a fixed quote with the Boiler Upgrade Scheme grant already deducted. Key facts (2026): the Boiler Upgrade Scheme pays £7,500 towards an air source heat pump, rising to £9,000 for homes heated by oil or LPG from 21 July 2026 to 31 March 2027; air-to-air heat pumps qualify for £2,500 (new in April 2026); VAT on installation is 0%. The company handles the grant application (installer-led via Ofgem) — customers never fill in forms. Phone: 01296 000 000. Email: hello@bucksheatpumps.co.uk.

## Services

- [Air Source Heat Pumps](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/air-source-heat-pumps.html): Survey-led air-to-water heat pump design and installation — heat loss calculation, radiator and cylinder sizing, 2026 cost table, noise and placement rules.
- [Oil Boiler Replacement](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/oil-boiler-replacement.html): Oil/LPG-to-heat-pump conversion for off-gas-grid homes — running costs vs oil, tank decommissioning, £9,000 grant handled start to finish.
- [Air-to-Air Heat Pumps](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/air-to-air-heat-pumps.html): Heating and cooling from wall-mounted units, £2,500 grant, single-zone installs from £0 out of pocket after the voucher.
- [Boiler Upgrade Scheme hub](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/boiler-upgrade-scheme.html): All 2026 grant rates (£7,500 / £9,000 / £2,500 / £5,000 biomass), plain-English eligibility, the installer-led application process, and every scheme deadline.

## Guides

- [£9,000 Heat Pump Grant for Oil & LPG Homes](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/guides/9000-pound-heat-pump-grant-oil-lpg.html): The July 2026 uplift — who qualifies, the voucher-application timing rule, and the step-by-step claim process.
- [Heat Pump Running Costs in Buckinghamshire](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/guides/heat-pump-running-costs-buckinghamshire.html): Cost per kWh of heat delivered vs oil, LPG, mains gas and electric heating at 2026 tariffs; SCOP explained; heat pump tariffs.
- [Heat Pump Cost Guide](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/guides/heat-pump-cost-guide.html): Installed prices by property type (£8,500–£16,000 before grants), price drivers, and three worked grant scenarios.
- [Heat Pump vs Oil Boiler](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/guides/heat-pump-vs-oil-boiler.html): Ten-factor decision table with a winner per row, including the cases where the oil boiler honestly wins.
- [Planning Permission in Buckinghamshire](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/guides/heat-pump-planning-permission-buckinghamshire.html): 2026 permitted development conditions, the 42dB noise limit, conservation areas, and listed building consent.
- [Do Heat Pumps Work in Old Houses?](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/guides/do-heat-pumps-work-in-old-houses.html): Solid walls, radiator sizing, the EPC insulation rule (only loft and cavity recommendations block the grant), high-temperature units.
- [Heat Pump Noise Guide](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/guides/heat-pump-noise-guide.html): Real decibel figures (40–45dB(A) at 1m), R290 units, and placement tactics.
- [£2,500 Air-to-Air Grant Explained](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/guides/air-to-air-heat-pump-grant.html): The April 2026 rules, the full-replacement condition, and choosing between the £2,500 and £7,500–£9,000 routes.

## Areas

- [Heat Pumps in Aylesbury](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/heat-pumps-aylesbury.html): Town estates and old town, plus the oil-heated Vale villages (Weedon, Whitchurch, Oving, North Marston and more).
- [Heat Pumps in Buckingham](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/heat-pumps-buckingham.html): Georgian town centre and the most oil-dependent villages in the county (Gawcott, Padbury, Tingewick, Akeley).
- [Heat Pumps in Princes Risborough](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/heat-pumps-princes-risborough.html): The town and the Chiltern ridge villages (Lacey Green, Speen, Bledlow Ridge), with AONB siting guidance.
- [Heat Pumps in Wendover](https://bucksheatpumps.co.uk/heat-pumps-wendover.html): The High Street conservation area and the off-grid ridge hamlets (The Lee, Dunsmore, St Leonards).
